headline: HISTORICALLY THE MOST INTENSIVE FINANCIAL PACKAGE, THANKS TO THE PRESIDENT: Minister Mesarović on the Details of the Huge State Aid to the Economy
summary: Deputy Prime Minister Adrijana Mesarović said a state support package for small businesses is the most intensive ever, in both financial value and eligible applicants. The package was announced the previous day.
why: State support for small businesses affects domestic demand, employment and lending conditions in the Serbian economy.
